messages:
Rina M: Quick sync: finalizing the observability beta surface. Customers want useful signals but we must be explicit about limits.
Owen L: Core asks = per-route cost, SLO templates, model_version correlation in traces.
Priya K: Pilots (FinRegCo, MedAI) need CSV exports for billing, and the ability to see if a p99 spike aligns with a recent model rollout. Week 5 pilot target.
Ben T: Ops reality: raw spans retention = 7d, aggregated metrics = 30d. Full sampling across all routes is not viable.
Rina M: Proposed MVP items:
- Template dashboard: p50/p95/p99, error rate, token spend, top routes
- Cost export: per-route daily token CSV + top-N per-model breakdown
- Tracing header for route+model_version, sample-on-error + adaptive sampling for >50 QPS routes
- Error analytics: group by exception signature + model_version, show 3 redacted examples
Owen L: Suggest single header to avoid parsing fragility: X-RW-META: route=/v1/gen;model=rw-7b;ver=2026-02-14. Make model_version enumerated.
Priya K: Pilot acceptance checklist:
- Filter cost by route and model_version
- Correlate p99 spike with a model rollout in last 24h
- Click error group -> see redacted examples
- Download CSV matching billing cadence
Ben T: Dev estimates (rough): dashboard templates 1.5 sprints, cost pipeline 2 sprints, tracing & sampler 1 sprint, error grouping UI 2 sprints -> ~6.5 sprints. Can compress by reusing widgets.
Dora G: Marketing will label this as "sampled traces, limited retention" and wants a short UI disclaimer + learn-more doc.
Rina M: Decision: MVP = CSV export + template dashboard + tracing header + error grouping (7d examples). Stretch: raw-span drilldown and 30d raw exports.
Action items:
- Owen: header spec + sampling defaults (due Fri)
- Ben: retention/export design + S3 export flow (due Mon)
- Rina: acceptance checklist + UI blurb (due Tue)
- Priya: confirm pilot sign-offs and redaction constraints (due Tue)
infra-bot: deploybot: obs-canary scheduled 03:00 UTC tomorrow; ping #eng-oncall on failure.
Owen L: Note: auto-upsample sampling for 30m after a model_version rollout to catch regressions.
Priya K: Customers okay with that as long as trade-offs are documented.
Rina M: Locking this for CTL review Wednesday. Thanks everyone.
Owen L: +1
Ben T: +1
Priya K: +1
Dora G: +1 :rocket:
